contexts.text: A customary formula with the ancients...
It was customary in the Ancient Church...
Hence it is customary in worship...

There are some customary things which are only formal, and there are some customary things which are at the same time essential: among the latter are weddings. That these are among the essential things which are to be manifested in the customary way. Explained.
To observe the solemnities of worship...
